cohort: 75 pregnant women presenting with severe anemia and a control group of non-anemic pregnant women delivering at or more than 28 weeks of gestation at Christian Medical College and Hospital, Ludhiana, India.
finding: Pregnant women with moderate and severe anemia had significantly higher rates of antenatal complications, past medical history, history of blood transfusion, requirement of blood transfusion, postpartum complications, and lower birth weight and APGAR scores at 1 minute compared to non-anemic pregnant women.
